ORIGINAL QUESTION
"What is the documented way to recover a stalled RillPrint 4 queue?"

SUPPLIED SOURCE EVIDENCE
[
  {
    "path": "docs/rillprint/recover-stalled-queue.md",
    "text": "# Recovering a stalled queue\n\n- This procedure applies only to RillPrint 4 queues that are already in maintenance mode.\n- Before any purge, export the job manifest.\n- A purge is permitted only when the upstream feeder is stopped AND the device buffer is empty.\n- If any job is marked `held`, stop recovery and leave the queue paused; do not purge or resume it.\n- After the purge, a successful `spool-verify` run is required before the queue may be resumed.\n- Uploading a diagnostic bundle is optional.\n- Archived job receipts must remain unchanged throughout recovery.\n",
    "line_start": 1,
    "line_end": 9,

  }
]
